subject: economics
title: Inflation & Price Stability
summary: Mechanisms used by central banks (such as RBI repo rate adjustments) to maintain price stability and manage economic growth.
canonical_facts: Inflation targets in India are set by the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) at 4% +/- 2%.
Demand-pull inflation occurs when aggregate demand exceeds supply capacity.
Cost-push inflation stems from supply shocks like rising oil or raw material prices.

subject: economics
title: Fiscal Policy & Budgeting
summary: Use of government spending, taxation, and borrowing to influence economy-level aggregate demand and redistribution.
canonical_facts: FRBM Act targets fiscal deficit reduction to maintain macroeconomic sustainability.
Capital expenditure creates long-term revenue-generating public assets.
Revenue deficit represents excess of routine operational expenditure over receipts.
